Chapter 445: Chapter 14 Eighth Shuttle (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 445: Chapter 14 Eighth Shuttle (Please Subscribe)

Advising Ruan Wei was indeed a casual act for Lin Yuan.

For over a decade, Ruan Wei had been hustling around for the matters of the Milky Way Star Region.

Lin Yuan had observed all this, and now realizing that the other party was on the wrong path, he didn’t mind pulling him back.

After all, for Lin Yuan, it was just a matter of a few words, without costing him anything.

He was just tired from his cultivation; it was merely a small effort.

After wandering around outside for a while.

...

Lin Yuan then returned to the palace.

Buzz.

Lin Yuan connected his consciousness to the Virtual World and arrived at the top of a mountain.

Under the vault of the sky, that part of the body still existed, as if it had never changed through the ages.

“Continue to ponder.”

Lin Yuan scanned his surroundings. Many Evolvers had started to attempt to cease their cultivation in favor of comprehending more evolution paths.

But this group of Evolvers only constituted a tiny minority, having to endure tremendous pressure from their spirit will and to comprehend various evolution paths…

Even with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, Lin Yuan had spent quite some time achieving this, other talented Evolvers aiming to tread this path could not say it was utterly impossible.

But that was a matter for many years later.

This was also why when Lin Yuan told the Goddess of Wisdom about this method of comprehension, he only received one million five hundred thousand Merit Points in return.

It was too difficult, just like giving an emperor a set of blueprints for a nuclear power plant during the feudal dynasty era.

Honestly, Lin Yuan still felt that choosing to cultivate a certain evolution path and perfecting it to the final stage to become an ordinary member of the Magic Jade Tower was more reliable.

“This evolution path… life rules also have this aspect? Marvelous!”

Lin Yuan continued to ponder, comprehending one evolution path after another, dissecting them, and realizing the parts that were helpful to him.

Over the past decade, Lin Yuan had understood more than twenty thousand kinds of evolution paths from this body segment, each evolution path greatly benefiting him.

“Just a part of the body contains nearly myriad evolution paths. Is this what a Supreme Being is?”

“I wonder when I, Lin Yuan, can become such an existence?”

Throughout his continuous comprehension, Lin Yuan gradually sensed the heights at which the Supreme Beings stood.

It was incredible.

That kind of ultimate control over a path, an eternal existence that even time couldn’t erode—what kind of scenery would that be?

Lin Yuan had also seen the Xia Qin Supreme Being, but the latter did not release any useful aura.

Lin Yuan did not discern anything from him.

“This body segment, merely a projection through the Virtual World, really creates unnaturally strong impacts on the outside world… ”

Lin Yuan thought while continuing to ponder.

“Just a next-stage member of the Magic Jade Tower, how many kinds of evolution paths do I need to comprehend thoroughly? I’ve already figured out more than twenty thousand, and it hasn’t triggered yet? Could it be that I need three hundred thirty-three thousand, three hundred and thirty-three kinds?”

Lin Yuan’s eyes narrowed slightly.

To thoroughly comprehend three thousand three hundred and thirty-three evolution paths and automatically become an ordinary member of the Magic Jade Tower.

Lin Yuan had already figured out more than twenty thousand kinds of evolution paths, and there was reason to speculate that the next-stage members of the Magic Jade Tower required three hundred thirty-three thousand, three hundred and thirty-three kinds of evolution paths.

Over thirty thousand kinds of evolution paths… although it’s ten times three thousand three hundred and thirty-three, the difficulty absolutely increased exponentially.

Lin Yuan even doubted whether being an ordinary member of the Magic Jade Tower was already the limit, with no further stages of membership levels.

“It doesn’t matter.”

“Thirty thousand kinds or three hundred thousand kinds.”

“As long as they help me, I will continue to comprehend.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts and entered a deep state of contemplation.

…

Cang Lan Star Virtual World.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared, his parents and sister were already sitting there.

“Xiaoyuan.”

Mother Lu Qiong greeted him with a smile.

“Brother.” Lin Yi looked up in admiration.

Ten years had passed, and Lin Yi had grown up, accessing many matters of the upper echelons of the human civilization thanks to her relationship with Lin Yuan.

This made her aware of her brother’s extraordinary existence.

He was a super exceptional genius, dazzling across the entire Human Civilization Alliance, competing with the offspring of Supreme Beings.

Because of Lin Yuan, Canglan Star, an inconspicuous Middle-grade Life Planet, leaped to become a hot star in both the Chikun Star Domain and the Annan Star Alliance.

Many powerful families from various star domains specially sent their descendants to Canglan Star to expand their progeny.

If Canglan Star could give birth to a super exceptional genius like Lin Yuan, it indicated its special characteristics; otherwise, why hadn’t the higher-grade life planets given birth to such a super exceptional genius like Lin Yuan?

This was the reason why the most popular industry on Canglan Star turned out to be the fertility industry?

Having their offspring born on Canglan Star, even with a one-in-a-billion chance, as long as they could produce descendants with one millionth of the capability of a Galactic Star Master, it was worth it.

“How’s your cultivation going recently?” Lin Yuan chatted casually with his parents.

After stepping into the Eighth Layer, Lin Yuan began to pay attention to the cultivation status of his family members.

Even occasionally offering advice.

His purpose in doing so.

Naturally was to hope that his parents and sister could live longer.

With the advanced technology of human civilization, even if one did not become an Evolver, there were many ways to prolong life.

But among all the methods to extend life, evolution, that is, becoming an Evolver, was the most perfect and had the least side effects.

“Our aptitude is probably not very good, Xiaoyuan. We need a long time to comprehend those analysis videos you provided,” said father Lin Shoucheng, shaking his head.

In the beginning, he had high hopes for the path of evolution, thinking he could produce a super genius like Lin Yuan.
